title: HPE security advisory (AV26-1011)
description: As of October 6, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
HPE Networking AOS-Switch (AOS-S)
	Version 16.11.0031 and prior

HP Networking ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM)
	Version 6.11.15 and prior
Version 6.14.0 and prior
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
